That code belongs to the VDBE and planner, which the contract leaves mutable. SQLite gets distinct values from the ordered covering index orders_cust, seeking past duplicates. Turso can do the same with a planner/VDBE change. The only frozen work is reading at most 730 index pages through the async I/O layer, roughly 1–3 ms. Turso's start-up overhead is mutable too."}
